mapper.select: SELECT DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) AS NAME, IFNULL(SUM(price), 0) AS VALUE FROM expense WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND expense_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AND positive = 0 GROUP BY DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) ORDER BY DAYOFWEEK(expense_time)

SELECT CASE WHEN DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) = 2 THEN '周一' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) = 3 THEN '周二' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) = 4 THEN '周三' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) = 5 THEN '周四' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) = 6 THEN '周五' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) = 7 THEN '周六' WHEN DAYOFWEEK(expense_time) = 1 THEN '周日' END AS NAME, IFNULL(SUM(price), 0) AS VALUE FROM expense WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND expense_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AND positive = 1 GROUP BY NAME
SELECT type AS NAME, SUM(price) AS VALUE FROM expense WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND expense_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK) AND positive = 0 GROUP BY type
